description_en: Invokes InsertList to bulk insert data
kebab_example: aliyun rds-data insert-list --secret-arn acs:rds-api:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:rds-db-credenti000/mySecret-Uy0000 --resource-arn acs:rds:cn-hangzhou:1266348003000000:dbinstance/rm-1234567890abc0000 --database test_db --table user --transaction-id 86090000-94e1-45ce-8e25-354e3dd80000 --records '["example-string"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: InsertList

parameters.help_en: The user credential of the Data API account. You can call the DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain the value of this parameter. Format: `acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
parameters.help_zh: Data API账号的用户凭证，您可调用DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取该参数的值。格式如下：`acs:rds:{{region}}:{{accountId}}:rds-db-credentials/{{secretName}}-{{6 digits random string}}`
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that specifies the resource to access. Format: ```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

Parameter description:

regionId: the region ID. You can invoke the DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain this value.
accountId: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can invoke the DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html) operation to obtain this value.
instanceId: the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
用于指向用户希望访问的资源，格式如下：```acs:rds:{{regionId}}:{{accountId}}:dbinstance/{{instanceId}}```

参数说明如下：

regionId：地域ID，可调用DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取。
accountId：阿里云账号ID，可调用DescribeSecrets (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446624.html)接口获取。
instanceId：实例ID
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transaction to commit. You can call the BeginTransaction operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 需要提交的事务ID，您可调用BeginTransaction接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: transaction_id

parameters.help_en: The data to bulk insert. The data structure is an array, where each item represents a record
parameters.help_zh: 要批量插入的数据，数据结构为array数组，每一项为一条记录
parameters.name: records
